newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS - MOGAS, FUEL UP, GAS OIL SLIPS.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS - MOGAS, FUEL UP, GAS OIL SLIPS.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday, traders said.

High sulphur fuel oil barges moved up slightly to $96.25 fob a tonne with low avails propping up the market. High sulphur cargoes were also seen stronger, with a Russian cracked M-100 reported traded at two means +$2.75, reflecting a tight market.
One percent was quiet but levels were notionally steady at $96/$97, with strength coming in from swaps which rose 50 cents.
Gas oil slipped 75 cents in line with Spetmeber Ipe which settled at $170.00 a tonne. Barge and cargo spreads were stable but trade was inactive.
